<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8" />
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1" />
<title>Habit Tracker</title>
<link rel="icon" href="data:image/svg+xml,<svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 100 100'><text y='.9em' font-size='90'>%E2%9C%85</text></svg>" />
<style>
*,*::before,*::after{box-sizing:border-box}
html,body{margin:0}
:root{
  --bg:#f4f5f7; --card:#ffffff; --text:#16181d; --muted:#6b7280; --line:#e6e8ec;
  --accent:#2f6feb; --accent-ink:#ffffff; --accent-soft:#e9f0fe;
  --done:#12854a; --done-soft:#e6f6ec; --danger:#c62828; --danger-soft:#fdecec;
  --radius:16px;
  --shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(16,24,40,.05), 0 8px 24px rgba(16,24,40,.06);
}
@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark){
  :root{
    --bg:#0f1115; --card:#171a21; --text:#e8eaee; --muted:#9aa3af; --line:#262b34;
    --accent:#5b8cff; --accent-ink:#0b0d12; --accent-soft:#1b2740;
    --done:#4ade80; --done-soft:#14291d; --danger:#ff8080; --danger-soft:#2a1616;
    --shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.4), 0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.35);
  }
}
body{
  background:var(--bg); color:var(--text);
  font:16px/1.5 -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI",Roboto,Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif;
  -webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;
}
.app{max-width:640px;margin:0 auto;padding:32px 20px 72px}
.app__header h1{margin:0;font-size:1.6rem;letter-spacing:-.02em}
.today{margin:6px 0 0;color:var(--muted);font-size:.9rem}
.sr-only{position:absolute;width:1px;height:1px;padding:0;margin:-1px;overflow:hidden;clip:rect(0 0 0 0);white-space:nowrap;border:0}
/* add form */
.add-form{display:flex;gap:8px;margin:24px 0 8px}
.add-form input{
  flex:1 1 auto;min-width:0;padding:12px 14px;font:inherit;color:var(--text);
  background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:12px;box-shadow:var(--shadow);
}
.add-form input::placeholder{color:var(--muted)}
.add-form input:focus-visible,.btn:focus-visible,.day:focus-visible{
  outline:2px solid var(--accent);outline-offset:2px;
}
.btn{
  font:inherit;cursor:pointer;border:1px solid transparent;border-radius:12px;
  padding:12px 16px;background:transparent;color:var(--text);transition:background .15s,border-color .15s,color .15s;
}
.btn--primary{background:var(--accent);color:var(--accent-ink);font-weight:600;white-space:nowrap}
.btn--primary:hover{filter:brightness(1.07)}
.btn--icon{padding:6px 10px;font-size:1rem;line-height:1;color:var(--muted);border-radius:10px}
.btn--icon:hover{background:var(--danger-soft);color:var(--danger)}
.warning{
  margin:16px 0 0;padding:12px 14px;border-radius:12px;font-size:.875rem;
  background:var(--danger-soft);color:var(--danger);border:1px solid var(--danger)
}
/* habit list */
.habits{list-style:none;margin:20px 0 0;padding:0;display:grid;gap:14px}
.habit{
  background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--radius);
  padding:16px;box-shadow:var(--shadow);
}
.habit.is-done{border-color:var(--done)}
.habit__head{display:flex;align-items:flex-start;gap:8px}
.habit__name{margin:0;font-size:1.05rem;font-weight:600;overflow-wrap:anywhere;flex:1 1 auto}
.habit__meta{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;margin:10px 0 12px;font-size:.8125rem}
.chip{padding:3px 9px;border-radius:999px;background:var(--accent-soft);color:var(--accent);font-weight:600;white-space:nowrap}
.chip--muted{background:transparent;color:var(--muted);font-weight:500;border:1px solid var(--line)}
.chip--done{background:var(--done-soft);color:var(--done)}
</style>
</head>
<body>
</body>
</html>

# Habit Tracker

A small, dependency-free habit tracker. One file, no build step, no network calls.

## Run it

Either open `index.html` directly, or (recommended, so browser storage is always
available) serve the folder over HTTP:

```sh
python3 -m http.server 8000
# then open http://localhost:8000/
```

## What it does

- **Add a habit** — type a name and press Enter (or *Add habit*). Max 60 characters.
- **Tick off today** — the big button at the bottom of each card toggles today.
- **Last 7 days** — every card shows the last 7 days, oldest on the left, today on
  the right (outlined). Click any of them to fix a day you forgot; the button is
  pressed-in/green when the day is done.
- **Streak count** — the blue chip shows consecutive completed days ending today.
  If today isn't ticked yet the streak is still alive, so it counts back from
  yesterday instead (the card explains this in the hint text). A second chip shows
  the best streak ever, and a third shows how many of the last 7 days were done.
- **Delete a habit** — the ✕ in the top-right corner, with a confirmation prompt.
- **Remembered on return** — everything is saved to `localStorage` on every change,
  and re-rendered on the next visit. Multiple tabs stay in sync.

## Data

Saved under the localStorage key `habit-tracker.v1` as:

```json
{
  "version": 1,
  "habits": [
    {
      "id": "h_lq3k8f2a9c",
      "name": "Read 10 pages",
      "createdAt": "2026-10-30",
      "done": { "2026-10-28": true, "2026-10-29": true, "2026-10-30": true }
    }
  ]
}
```

Dates are `YYYY-MM-DD` keys built from **local** calendar parts (never
`toISOString()`), so a habit ticked at 11pm stays on that day, and streaks survive
DST changes. Corrupt or malformed entries are filtered out on load instead of
crashing the app.

## Tests

Open `index.html#selftest` to run the built-in checks for the date maths, streak
counting, the 7-day window and the storage round-trip. The results appear in a
panel at the bottom of the page (and in the console). The tests only use
throwaway fixtures, so your saved habits are never modified.

- Accessibility: labelled controls, `aria-pressed` on toggles, descriptive `aria-label`s per day ("Thursday, 29 Oct — done, tap to undo"), focus preserved across re-render, and a light/dark theme via `prefers-color-scheme`.

## How to run

```sh
cd /private/tmp/.../scratchpad/d-code-1/work/apps
python3 -m http.server 8000   # then open http://localhost:8000/
```
Double-clicking `index.html` also works, but serving over HTTP guarantees `localStorage` is available in every browser (the app detects a blocked store and shows a warning banner rather than silently losing data).

## Requirements → implementation

- **Add habits** — form at the top (`maxlength=60`, trims whitespace, ignores blank/whitespace-only input, keeps focus so you can add several in a row).
- **Tick off today** — big toggle button per card ("Mark done for today" ⇄ "✓ Done today — tap to undo"). The card border and chip turn green when today is done.
- **Last 7 days per habit** — a 7-column grid, oldest → newest, today outlined and labelled; each cell is a button showing the weekday letter + day number, pressed-in/green when done. Clicking a past day corrects it (also gives you the "I forgot yesterday" case).
- **Streak count** — blue chip: consecutive completed days ending today, or ending yesterday if today isn't ticked yet (so the streak isn't killed by a day you haven't gotten to yet). Plus a "Best N" chip and an "N/7 this week" chip.
- **Remember everything** — saved to `localStorage` under `habit-tracker.v1` on every mutation; reloaded and re-rendered on return; `storage` events keep multiple tabs in sync; a 60-second timer re-renders when the calendar day rolls over in an open tab.
- **Delete a habit** — the ✕ per card, with a confirmation prompt, then focus returns to the input.

## Correctness details worth knowing

- Date keys are built from **local** calendar parts (`YYYY-MM-DD`), never `toISOString()`, so an 11pm tick stays on that day and `addDays` is DST-safe.
- `isValidDateKey` round-trips through `Date`, so junk like `2026-13-01` or `2026-02-31` in storage can't create a phantom day; malformed habits/entries are filtered on load instead of crashing.
- User text is rendered with `textContent` / `<template>` cloning — no `innerHTML`, so habit names can't inject markup.
- Accessibility: labelled controls, `aria-pressed` on toggles, descriptive `aria-label`s per day ("Thursday, 29 Oct — done, tap to undo"), focus preserved across re-render, and a light/dark theme via `prefers-color-scheme`.

Done. Here's what I built and verified.

## Files created

| File | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `index.html` | The whole app — markup, CSS and JS in one dependency-free file (695 lines) |
| `README.md` | How to run it, feature notes, storage format, how to run the tests |

## How to run

```sh
cd /private/tmp/.../scratchpad/d-code-1/work/apps
python3 -m http.server 8000   # then open http://localhost:8000/
```
Double-clicking `index.html` also works, but serving over HTTP guarantees `localStorage` is available in every browser (the app detects a blocked store and shows a warning banner rather than silently losing data).

## Requirements → implementation

- **Add habits** — form at the top (`maxlength=60`, trims whitespace, ignores blank/whitespace-only input, keeps focus so you can add several in a row).
- **Tick off today** — big toggle button per card ("Mark done for today" ⇄ "✓ Done today — tap to undo"). The card border and chip turn green when today is done.
- **Last 7 days per habit** — a 7-column grid, oldest → newest, today outlined and labelled; each cell is a button showing the weekday letter + day number, pressed-in/green when done. Clicking a past day corrects it (also gives you the "I forgot yesterday" case).
- **Streak count** — blue chip: consecutive completed days ending today, or ending yesterday if today isn't ticked yet (so the streak isn't killed by a day you haven't gotten to yet). Plus a "Best N" chip and an "N/7 this week" chip.
- **Remember everything** — saved to `localStorage` under `habit-tracker.v1` on every mutation; reloaded and re-rendered on return; `storage` events keep multiple tabs in sync; a 60-second timer re-renders when the calendar day rolls over in an open tab.
- **Delete a habit** — the ✕ per card, with a confirmation prompt, then focus returns to the input.

## Correctness details worth knowing

- Date keys are built from **local** calendar parts (`YYYY-MM-DD`), never `toISOString()`, so an 11pm tick stays on that day and `addDays` is DST-safe.
- `isValidDateKey` round-trips through `Date`, so junk like `2026-13-01` or `2026-02-31` in storage can't create a phantom day; malformed habits/entries are filtered on load instead of crashing.
- User text is rendered with `textContent` / `<template>` cloning — no `innerHTML`, so habit names can't inject markup.
- Accessibility: labelled controls, `aria-pressed` on toggles, descriptive `aria-label`s per day ("Thursday, 29 Oct — done, tap to undo"), focus preserved across re-render, and a light/dark theme via `prefers-color-scheme`.

## Validation

I don't have a shell/browser in this environment, so I couldn't execute the page myself. Instead I reviewed the full file line by line (balanced IIFE/braces, no leftover build markers, no stale `isDateKey` references) and added an **in-app test runner**: open `index.html#selftest` and it prints 30 checks — date-key padding, DST and year-boundary arithmetic, `isNextDay`, key validation, all six streak edge cases, the 7-day window boundary, corrupt-data repair, and a `localStorage` round-trip using a scratch key — plus a `N/N checks passed` line in a panel and the console. The tests use throwaway fixtures, so your saved habits are untouched.
